reviews.text: Awesome place to chill and mingle!. Its a down to earth spot where ALL are welcome. Ive been coming here, on and off, for about 6months now. The drink are top notch and so is the staff. This is highly recommended establishment!! C'mon down and be yourself.

reviews.author: Carla Van Sickle
reviews.text: Everyone was so welcoming and fun to talk with. Very informative. Lots of events that we WILL be coming back for and we live over 3 hours away 😲😊😊 That is a testament to how good of a first impression this spot made on us. Chase, our Kavatender, was the best. Quick and friendly service. Great community feels, chill vibes, and did I mention the drinks are delicious 😋 Tea was not bitter and kava was super smooth. I hope you get to make it in, you won't regret it! 🌸🥥BULA✨️

reviews.author: Diego Davila
reviews.text:
This Kava social club is easily one of the most unique and laid-back spots I’ve been to. The vibe is relaxed but alive, the kava is smooth and well-crafted, and the staff genuinely care about creating a welcoming space. It’s the kind of place where conversations flow just as easily as the drinks.

What really sets this place apart, though, is the chess club. Hands down the coolest chess scene around. You’ll find players of every level—from casual thinkers to serious strategists—and everyone is respectful, competitive, and encouraging. Games spark real conversations, friendly rivalries, and a sense of community you don’t find often anymore.

Whether you come for a quiet evening, a deep chess match, or just to meet interesting people in a calm, positive environment, this place delivers every time. If you’re into kava, community, or chess—or all three—this spot is an absolute must-visit.
